note: Factory kill switch. enabled=false pauses production mutations (claims, QA, publish) but keeps safety operations available: --recover, --consistency, writer-lock status/acquire/release, checkpoints, --progress. Write-ahead queue contract (owner-approved 2026-10-05, ported from the stable /vanchinh factory): one writer push queues at most queue_max_push (10) article files (scripts/factory_push_selection.py refuses more; out-of-range/missing config falls back to 10, never above). The queue is consumed as deterministic pairs of pair_size (2) by scripts/factory_queue.py inside the same factory-publish run: pair -> exact-ID claim -> scoped QA (exit 0/3/4) -> transactional publish -> next pair; a failed pair never rolls back already-published pairs. The ONLY scheduled workflow is the read-only liveness watchdog (factory-liveness.yml, schedule 0 */6 * * *, owner-approved 2026-10-05); everything else stays event-driven (test_no_cron_anywhere). A paused factory with a pending transaction can always be recovered via --recover. REPAIR pushes of already-claimed rows respect queue_max_push too.
